session_selection.time_basis: Selected root first persisted UTC event; workspace-local telemetry only.
session_selection.rationale: Manual root classification from workspace-local bundle: benchmark continuity and terminal response.

points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Clean immutable c06741d CMake build in cfd-bench passed with no CFD rerun; historic run/source binding remains unproved.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp solve parser validates required case/output paths and options. Restart saves state levels but transient resume resets time and starts with backward Euler (solver.cpp:757–846,1326–1343).

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: c06741d solver/src separates case parsing, mesh, partition, halo, physics, solver and output; fixed 2D/NVAR interfaces constrain extensions.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Reviewed submitted c06741d source and report descriptions; no reuse finding established. This is not an exhaustive external code-similarity audit.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_def.cpp:102–128 parses case BC families and run controls; cgns_read.cpp loops bases/zones and section types rather than branching on the two benchmark filenames.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: partition.cpp:308–363 performs root-only CGNS read, METIS graph partition and local-mesh distribution; halo.cpp:15–38 uses neighbor Irecv/Isend. Root gathers for final output/restart; historic results do not bind a production-source revision.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: solver.cpp:233–237 falls back on invalid face density/pressure and :478 onward scales unsafe updates; it also rolls back after divergence. Restart time and source binding limitations remain.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: main.cpp runSelfTest includes Roe consistency, reciprocity, stationary contact and viscous checks; rank comparisons are delivered but report overstates NACA agreement. Clean immutable build passed; no CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: c06741d CMake and separated source units build cleanly; absolute reproducibility of historic runs is limited by metadata revision pointing at init without solver code.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: physics.hpp fixes 2D perfect-gas conserved variables; case_def.cpp:166–176 sets freestream and Reynolds viscosity; report.tex:1–2 describes nondimensional equations.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: cgns_read.cpp:60–164 handles multiple bases/zones and TRI_3/QUAD_4/MIXED; :233–270 maps boundary sections, while partition.cpp:308–363 creates local meshes.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:188 onward assembles face residuals, includes inviscid and viscous terms and local/global residual reductions; physical result attribution to c06741d is not established.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: physics.cpp:27–98 implements Roe acoustic Harten fix and Rusanov alternative; source selftests include consistency and contact. Not a proof of all-flow accuracy.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:135–153 and :317–332 treat farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall; :369–378 writes actual wall boundary velocity semantics rather than claiming cell-center values.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:108–167 forms Green–Gauss primitive gradients and :212–230 reconstructs limited face states; source control may turn reconstruction off but selected production-source binding is unknown.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:169–183,212–230 computes Venkat-type limiter and :1181–1186 may freeze it; report.tex:589–591 discloses freeze. No proven DQ10 in selected production outputs with unavailable source binding.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: physics.cpp:178–215 derives temperature gradients from p and rho and Newtonian/Fourier flux; solver.cpp:323–351 projects shear tangentially for force split.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: solver.cpp:433–474 uses forward/backward LU-SGS sweeps with halo exchanges. Steady CFL cap 50 is documented in report.tex:586–588; source/results binding unknown.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1326–1403 implements BDF time residual and actual inner target miss accounting; selected Re200 metadata reports 167 misses/30000. Restart resets time and starts backward Euler; no proof this exact source produced selected run.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: partition.cpp:110–146 uses METIS graph partition; :325–347 root distributes local owned/ghost meshes before iteration; halo.cpp:15–38 exchanges neighbors.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Examiner validator recorded for all eight selected final packages; source restart serializes state levels but lacks physical time/step. Validator structure does not prove convergence or accuracy.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Structural examiner validation is recorded in the snapshot; manual Re200 plot and wake estimator checks, M2 laminar force stability and source provenance identify limitations beyond a validator pass.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 laminar metadata claims converged while final 40 Cd values fall 0.853765→0.529150; Re200 t300 and plotted late drag limitation are distinct. Selected historic outputs are not bound to immutable solver source.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 last Cd≈2.072 is stable; Re200 raw lift FFT≈0.175. Rank-study NACA np1 vs np8 final Cd 0.001153759 vs 0.001167319 and Cl −0.0012681 vs +0.0006058; Re20 Cd 2.071663 vs 2.071655. Report claim of solver-roundoff agreement overstates NACA agreement; absolute differences do not demonstrate an order-one force mismatch.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Delivered force histories and contours are readable, with compressed late drag. The Re200 vorticity wake figure is pixel-reproduced from selected field with the committed plotting helper; the helper fails an exact solid-rotation check and disagrees with an independent local-neighbor wake diagnostic. This is a derived-variable accuracy defect, not proof of a substituted field.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: c06741d report.tex:294–315 labels steady table values final though M2 Cd1.025 matches last100 mean rather than final0.529; text:445 gives 2.162. Rank agreement claim:529–533 overstates NACA agreement; PDF includes disclosure of CFL/limiter limitations.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: The 30-page accepted report and figure manifest are delivered. Re200 wake image pixel-reproduces from selected field and final plotting helper, which is mathematically defective; case metadata revision26ef1cb does not bind production solver source.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable c06741d clean build succeeded with CMake in cfd-bench; main.cpp:180–219 checks solve options and required paths. Restart stores three state levels but no time/step, and solver.cpp:1326–1343 resets transient clock and takes backward Euler on the first resumed step, so full transient continuation is not provided.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: cgns_read.cpp:60–164 handles unstructured multiple bases/zones and mixed TRI/QUAD, maps boundary families :233–270; mesh and partition structures carry adjacency. Historical run/source revision remains unbound.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: solver.cpp:188 onward assembles conservative face fluxes; physics.cpp Roe/Rusanov, farfield/slip/no-slip branches and adiabatic wall are present. Result provenance remains qualified.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: solver.cpp:108–167,212–230 gradients and limited reconstruction, positivity fallback :233–237, frozen limiter :1181–1186. Report discloses limiter freeze, but selected run metadata does not bind production source.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: physics.cpp:178–215 uses perfect-gas temperature gradient and Newtonian/Fourier flux; solver.cpp:323–351 uses tangential wall traction, :369–372 reports wall values.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: solver.cpp:433–474 LU-SGS and :1326–1403 BDF residual and actual inner statistics. Report.tex:586–588 discloses CFL cap 50 rather than supplied maximum 100; transient restart lacks time/step. Selected Re200 metadata 167/30000 inner misses; exact source binding unproved.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: partition.cpp:110–146,308–363 METIS/root distribution; halo.cpp:15–38 neighbor communication, solver.cpp:523,541 reductions and root output. Re20 and NACA rank comparisons delivered; report overstates NACA roundoff agreement.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Current M2 laminar metadata labels converged despite last40 Cd 0.853765→0.529150; Re200 raw lift gives St≈0.175 but late drag plot lacks resolution and wake vorticity estimate is inconsistent. Re20 is steady, and inviscid plateaus require force-based evaluation. Rank-study results exist; all selected metadata revision26ef1cb lacks solver source, so production binding remains unproved.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Immutable c06741d report.tex:523–525,592–593 labels wake figure as Green–Gauss vorticity, but delivered plotting helper fails rigid rotation (exact curl 2, returned 0). Regeneration from selected field gives pixel-identical submitted image; a separate local-neighbor least-squares diagnostic over 3875 wake cells correlates −0.026 with that helper. The plot is readable and field-derived but not credible as vorticity. Force startup scaling and M2 laminar summary inconsistencies further limit presentation. See report and ledger for source-binding limits.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Physics and mesh are separated into physics.hpp/mesh.hpp, and boundary families are case-driven; fixed 2D four-variable perfect-gas operations and BC branches constrain EOS, 3D and species extensions.

naca0012_m015_inviscid.notes: Original 4; interim 2; revised 3. Immutable c06741d force figure shows startup decay and resolved lift, although startup >1 compresses late Cd≈0.00117; its steady behavior is therefore not wholly absent. Raw last-10% Cd0.0011673–0.0011914, residual reduction 3.968 orders. Numeric summary, residual and field figures exist. Late-drag presentation and source binding limit credit. Metadata revision26ef1cb points to init without solver source; no CFD rerun.

naca0012_m080_inviscid.notes: NACA0012 M0.80 inviscid: numeric CL=-0.0008467, CD=0.009454 at c06741d:solver/report/report.tex:303; residual history c06741d:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m080_inviscid_residuals.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:352); force history c06741d:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m080_inviscid_forces.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:356); computed-field contour c06741d:solver/report/figures/naca0012_m080_inviscid_mach_zoom.png (referenced at solver/report/report.tex:364). Score 3 retained after the post-processing audit. Prior case judgment: M0.80 inviscid package passes validator but submitted report applies below-target shock-case force-plateau acceptance. Current last-10% raw residual/Cd/Cl were independently examined: M080 residual half-means0.01870→0.01562, Cd0.0094542→0.0094535, Cl0.002022→−0.000442; M2 residual0.01896→0.01888, Cd0.0886825→0.0886591, Cl0.001679→0.001681 with bounded oscillations. Below-target residual orders alone do not establish DQ7 under TASK.md:172; M080 lift stability and exact source binding remain qualified.

naca0012_m200_inviscid.notes: Original 2→3: immutable c06741d report.tex:305,376–388 and its PDF pp11–13 deliver numeric Cd0.08866/Cl0.001683, residual, force and Mach/pressure field plots. Raw last-10% residual half-means 0.01896→0.01888, Cd0.0886825→0.0886591 and Cl0.001679→0.001681 with bounded oscillations. This is a documented force plateau rather than a residual-target success (only ~0.14 orders), and plots show a plausible shock structure; the residual floor and unbound production source materially limit credit. Metadata revision26ef1cb is init without solver source. No CFD rerun.

cylinder_m010_laminar_re200.notes: Score 4.5→2: immutable c06741d report.tex:497 gives St0.175 and mean Cd1.16; selected raw force FFT peak t>=100 is 0.174991 and Cl spans −0.450674 to 0.4611, confirming oscillatory lift. Visually reviewed immutable forces.png: startup Cd excursions −120 to +40 compress late Cd, so no readable late lift/drag periodic-force plot; no alternate delivered late force plot found. Figure floor unmet. Metadata revision 26ef1cb is init without solver source; 167/30000 recorded inner misses do not imply missed-majority. No unsteady rerun.

flags.flag: metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful final results
flags.evidence: Current selected results/naca0012_m200_laminar_re5000 metadata says completed=true/converged at step406 with 3.004 orders, but last40 Cd rows fall 0.8537653491→0.5291502491 (38.0%), half means 0.76240268→0.59653982. TASK.md:140,172 require clear early convergence or stable force plateau. Source revision in metadata 26ef1cb names an initial commit with no solver source; do not infer final source generated these rows. The previous DQ7 rationale based only on below-target inviscid residual orders is not sufficient; those plateau claims remain independently under review.

limitations: No evaluator rerun was performed; cylinder Re200 was never rerun.
Structural validation is separate from substantive numerical scoring.
Raw solver artifacts remain workspace evidence and were excluded from the curated submission tip.
run_identity.json and contestant_final_response.md are unindexed sidecars.

2026-09-06 retrospective: all eight independent case scores were re-audited against the immutable contestant report at the recorded submission commit. Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.
